name: WIR PFLÜGEN
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of We Plow the Fields and Scatter (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/We_Plow_the_Fields_and_Scatter/, “Wir Pflügen”, Johann A. P. Schulz, 1800), whose music it marks public domain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. It agrees note for note, all 79 notes, with the soprano of CCEH’s own MIDI file (https://www.ccel.org/cceh/0010/001081a.mid, read with tools/blog/import/midi.mjs). CCEH’s page incipit (sddssmd|sfmrds|sltdmrdt, https://www.ccel.org/cceh/0010/x001081.htm) and hymnary.org’s (51155 31543 21556, https://hymnary.org/tune/wir_pflugen_schulz) write the start of the second line rising (s l t d) where both scores fall (s d t l); that mismatch is why the CCEH importer rejected the tune. The two scores are kept; check the second line against a printed British hymn book. No hand fixes. Schulz’s dates (1747–1800) and the year 1800 are from https://hymnary.org/tune/wir_pflugen_schulz.
